tools.name: get_proof_of_reserve
tools.description: Get WBTC collateralization health only. 中文触发词：抵押率、储备率、Proof of Reserve、是否足额 1:1 抵押。Use this for questions like “WBTC 当前抵押率是多少？”. Returns reserveRatio and updatedAt. Does not return supply, reserve asset values, or chain contract metadata; use get_supply, get_reserves, or list_chains for those.

tools.name: get_supply
tools.description: Get WBTC circulating supply only. 中文触发词：流通量、供应量、Native 链供应量、各链分布。Use this for questions like “WBTC 当前流通量是多少？各 Native 链分别是多少？”. Returns circulatingSupply and native-chain byChain records with chain, chainKey, and supply. Does not return reserveRatio, reserve asset values, BTC price, or contract addresses.

tools.name: get_reserves
tools.description: Get WBTC reserve asset values only. 中文触发词：BTC 储备、储备数量、储备美元价值、储备估值、BTC 价格。Use this for questions like “WBTC 的 BTC 储备有多少，美元价值是多少？”. Returns nativeBtcReserve, btcPriceUsd, reserveValueUsd, and updatedAt. Does not return reserveRatio, supply by chain, reserve address evidence, or contract metadata.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List WBTC supported chains and contract metadata only. 中文触发词：支持链、Native 链、Bridge 链、合约地址、浏览器链接、contract address。Use this for questions like “列出 WBTC 支持的 native 链和合约地址。”. Returns native/bridge chain metadata, deployment, isNew, and contract details with full contractAddress and explorerUrl. Does not return supply, reserveRatio, or reserve asset values.

tools.name: list_custodian_addresses
tools.description: List public WBTC custodian BTC reserve address evidence only. 中文触发词：Custodian 地址、托管地址、储备地址、BTC 地址明细、地址余额。Returns addresses with balanceBtc, explorerUrl, total, and updatedAt. Does not return reserveRatio, supply by chain, chain contracts, merchants, or ecosystem projects.

tools.name: list_mint_burn_records
tools.description: List public WBTC mint and burn records with pagination. 中文触发词：mint/burn 记录、铸造记录、销毁记录、最近 20 条、交易记录、txHash。Use this for questions like “查一下最近 20 条 WBTC mint/burn 记录。”. Supports pageIndex, pageSize capped at 200, action, status, network, and merchantName filters. Invalid action/status/network values are ignored by the Public API and fall back to broader results. Does not return supply totals, reserveRatio, custodian addresses, or chain contract metadata.

pageSize.description: Requested page size. Values above 200 are capped to 200 before calling the Public API.

tools.name: list_merchants
tools.description: List public WBTC merchant directory entries only. 中文触发词：Merchant、商户、做市商、merchant 名录、商家列表。Returns name, description, tags, website, and updatedAt; optional tag narrows results. Does not return custodian-only entries, logos, internal display fields, mint/burn records, reserve data, or chain contracts.

tools.name: list_custodians
tools.description: List public WBTC custodian directory entries only. 中文触发词：Custodian、托管方、保管方、custodian 名录、有哪些 WBTC custodian。Use this for questions like “有哪些 WBTC custodian？”. Returns name, description, website, and updatedAt. Does not return merchant-only entries, logos, internal display fields, reserve addresses, reserveRatio, or chain contract metadata.

tools.name: list_ecosystem_projects
tools.description: List public WBTC ecosystem projects only. 中文触发词：生态项目、生态、DeFi 项目、wallet、bridge、合作项目。Use this for questions like “WBTC 生态里有哪些 DeFi 项目？”. Supports optional category and network filters and returns project name, category, networks, url, and updatedAt. Does not return logos, content-management fields, providers, merchants, reserve data, or chain contract metadata.
